verdict: Yes, as a mission-driven business. Atypical Advantage from Jamshedpur pitched a platform for persons with disabilities on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Companies want to hire more people with disabilities but don't know where to find them, and a platform that connects both sides can earn from hiring fees and services.
angle: India has millions of people with disabilities, and most are outside formal employment. Companies with diversity targets pay for hiring, training and accessibility audits. Art, talent and services marketplaces can add income.
